dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The secret surveillance was pretty successful. You completely bluffed them, General Gorou! That said, I didn't drink because I looked too young... (contents deleted)"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "You idiot! Now everyone in Inazuma knows (contents hurriedly scrubbed) is me, General Gorou!"

dialogues.speaker: A Third Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Please stop writing! This has to be part of the owner's scheme! He intentionally using the message board to lure you to reveal critical intel, exposing the whereabouts of the surveillance team. That's got to be it!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "It's okay as long as we have deleted the critical information, such as... (contents hurriedly scrubbed)"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Reply
dialogues.text: In the end, nothing was removed...
